relations.text_en: Largest customer, accounting for 16% of net sales in 2025

source.label: Kimberly-Clark 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Our largest customer, Walmart Inc., represented approximatel y 16% i n 2025 and 2024 and 15% in 2023 of our net sales from continuing operations.

relations.text: 旧IFP事業の合弁会社でスザノ側が51%を取得し、当社は49%を保持する予定
relations.text_en: Suzano's buyer is to acquire 51% of the joint venture for the former IFP business while K-C retains 49%

source.label: Kimberly-Clark 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: Buyer will acquire a 51% interest in the Joint Venture for a purchase price of approximately $1.7 billion, subject to certain closing adjustments set forth in the Purchase Agreement, and we will retain a 49% equity interest

relations.text_en: K-C entered into a merger agreement to acquire the outstanding equity interests of Kenvue

source.label: Kimberly-Clark 10-K(2025-12-31)
source.quote: On November 2, 2025, we entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") to acquire the outstanding equity interests of Kenvue, Inc. ("Kenvue"), a global consumer health leader, for stock and cash consideration (the "Kenvue Acquisition").
